mapper.select: select fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as prodid, fin.FINPROD_ID as finprodid, fin.FINPROD_ABBR as shortname, fin.FINPROD_NAME as prodname, finadd.SALE_DEPARTMENT as mktdeptno, proparam.PRD_BAND as prodtype1, pa.DEAL_MODE as prodmode, pa.DEAL_MODE as rollmode, declare1.REP_FINPROD_STAGE as productperiod, fin.ENTRUST_TYPE as issuetype, (case fin.ENTRUST_TYPE when #{danyi,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then fin.ENTRUSTER else '' end) as branch, DATE_FORMAT(fin.VDATE,'%Y%m%d') as vdate, DATE_FORMAT(fin.MDATE,'%Y%m%d') as mdate, fin.TERM_DAYS as term, calcrule.BASIS as basis, (case finadd.IS_LAY when #{yes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then null else calcrule.YIELD end) as yield, proparam.FIRST_SALE_VDATE as ssdate, proparam.FIRST_SALE_MDATE as sedate from FIN_PRODUCT fin left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT pa on fin.FINPROD_ID = pa.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_CASH_INFO cash on fin.FINPROD_ID = cash.FINPROD_ID and cash.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{xjint,jdbcType=VARCHAR} left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE calcrule on calcrule.CASH_ID = cash.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE payrule on payrule.CASH_ID = cash.CASH_ID left join PRD_SALE_PARAM proparam on fin.FINPROD_ID = proparam.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd on finadd.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID left join REP_PROD_DECLARE declare1 on fin.FINPROD_ID = declare1.REP_FINPROD_ID where fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{lcprod,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
